  "title": "佩洛西又出手了：LEAPS老手的1350万美元AI电力豪赌",
  "topics": [
    "LEAPS options",

    "Bloom Energy",
    "Intel",
    "Pelosi trades",

    "STOCK Act disclosures",
    "options education"
  ],
  "key_takeaways": [
    "Pelosi family added Bloom Energy and Intel using stock plus deep-in-the-money LEAPS calls expiring June 2027, not short-term speculative options.",
    "The structure is a stock-replacement strategy: deep ITM calls with roughly 0.9 delta provide near-stock upside while defining downside to the premium paid.",
    "The thesis targets AI infrastructure 'picks and shovels' including compute chips, power, on-site fuel cells, and CPUs rather than chasing AI model companies.",
    "Long-dated LEAPS give the investment thesis time to play out; many options losses come from wrong time horizon rather than wrong direction.",
    "Following disclosed political trades has limits because STOCK Act allows 45-day delayed disclosure and the market may already price in the news."
  ],
  "strategies": [
    "Stock + Deep ITM LEAPS Call (Stock Replacement)",
    "Long-Dated LEAPS Call",
    "Bullish Call Option",
    "Thematic / Sector Investing",
    "Defined-Risk Leverage"
  ],
  "difficulty": "intermediate",
  "handbook_volume": "Options Strategy / LEAPS & Stock Replacement",
  "quotes": [
    "期权不是赌博工具，是思维的延伸。",
    "用期权放大确定性，而不是制造杠杆。",
    "选赛道而非选个股。"
  ],
  "summary": "The article analyzes Nancy Pelosi family's July 2026 disclosures showing new Bloom Energy and added Intel positions built with stock plus deep-in-the-money LEAPS calls. It explains the stock-replacement logic, defined-risk leverage, and long-dated thesis around the AI infrastructure supply chain. It also cautions that delayed STOCK Act disclosures mean followers may buy after the news is priced in."
}
